translation: Gather the root in the second and eighth months, dry [in the shade]. (節皮 is its envoy; obtaining oyster 牡蠣 and polygala 遠志 treats anger-vexation; obtaining saltpeter 硝石 and gypsum 石膏 treats cold damage. It is in dread of bletilla 白芨, longan 龍眼, and gentian 龍膽 ...) Original text of the Benjing: Platycodon (桔梗), flavor pungent, slightly [warm]
